interpretation.cross_system_pulse_does_not_encode_actua: The later rit is read as text; written eighth spacing is compared within a consistent rhythmic/font/stem context, not proportional wall-clock time.
interpretation.whole_note_positioning: The lower whole notes sit at the entry column while the upper staff moves. When all layers have only bar-length values, the heads move inward together; written x must be interpreted through musical roles.
